operations.title: Live forwarding overlay
operations.operation: Starts real asyncio TCP listeners on 127.0.0.1 and forwards real packets between them; a node failure closes its listener; delivery is confirmed by the destination's acknowledgement.
limitations: Loopback only: every node runs on this machine, so links have no physical delay or loss.

operations.title: Hysteresis vs naive detector comparison
operations.operation: Replays one supplied heartbeat sequence through both detectors and counts transitions.
operations.evidence: netrescue.playground:run_detector_comparison contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
operations.model: HysteresisStateMachine vs single-threshold detector over a supplied sequence
limitations: The heartbeat sequence is supplied by the user; no link is changed and no packet is sent.

operations.title: Multipath file transfer
operations.operation: Chunks the uploaded bytes, schedules chunks over logical paths with configured delay/loss, reassembles and verifies SHA-256. The file bytes and hashing are real; the paths are not.
operations.evidence: netrescue.transfer.session contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: A path is a modelled delay-and-loss profile inside one process, not a socket, interface or cable.

operations.title: Scheduler comparison
operations.operation: Runs FIFO and priority schedulers over identical generated arrivals.
operations.evidence: netrescue.traffic.experiment contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: Queueing-model output, not a measurement of a wire.

operations.title: Ping
operations.operation: Runs the operating system's ping command (argument list, no shell) and parses its output.
limitations: ICMP may be blocked by firewalls; a target with zero replies is reported as unreachable.

operations.title: Route trace
operations.operation: Runs the operating system's tracert/traceroute command and parses the hops.
limitations: Hops that do not answer ICMP appear as timeouts.

operations.title: DNS resolution
operations.operation: Resolves a name through the operating system resolver (socket.getaddrinfo).
limitations: Answers may come from the OS resolver cache.

operations.title: Adapters and gateway
operations.operation: Reads adapter, IP and gateway configuration from the operating system.
limitations: Read-only; no interface or route is modified.

operations.title: Repeated ping benchmark
operations.operation: Repeats real ping probes and aggregates latency and loss statistics.
limitations: Statistics describe the path to the chosen target at the time of the run.

operations.title: Fault scenario
operations.operation: Replays a seeded fault timeline (loss, jitter, timeout, intermittent) through a probe model.
operations.evidence: netrescue.diagnostics.faults:run_fault_scenario contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: No packet is sent; faults are generated by the scenario definition.

operations.title: Hysteresis sweep
operations.operation: Replays one identical seeded outcome sequence through detectors at several hysteresis ratios.
operations.evidence: netrescue.benchmark.sweep contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: The outcome sequence is generated, not measured.

operations.title: Scheduler comparison
operations.operation: Runs scheduler variants over declared logical paths with the same payload.
operations.evidence: netrescue.transfer.session contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: Declared path profiles, not live paths.

operations.title: Dijkstra shortest path
operations.operation: Runs Dijkstra's algorithm on the supplied graph and records every iteration.
operations.evidence: netrescue.labs.routing contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: A graph computation; it does not change any real routing table.

operations.title: TCP Reno congestion model
operations.operation: Discrete-event simulation of one TCP Reno flow over one bottleneck.
operations.evidence: netrescue.labs.tcp_cc contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: Not a kernel experiment; one variant, one flow, one bottleneck.

operations.title: Token bucket vs leaky bucket
operations.operation: Runs both shapers over one seeded packet-arrival list.
operations.evidence: netrescue.labs.shaping contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
operations.model: token bucket / leaky bucket with tail-drop queue
limitations: Models the algorithms; does not shape real traffic.

operations.title: TCP and UDP loopback experiment
operations.operation: Opens real TCP and UDP sockets on 127.0.0.1 and times connect, round trips and bulk transfer.
limitations: Loopback has no propagation delay, bandwidth limit or normal loss; no impairment is injected.

operations.title: TCP vs UDP model
operations.operation: Reno model versus a paced UDP sender over one modelled lossy bottleneck.
operations.evidence: netrescue.labs.tcp_udp:run_simulated contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
operations.model: TCP Reno vs paced UDP over a drop-tail bottleneck
limitations: No sockets are used; results come from the model and its seed.

operations.title: Detect → reroute → transfer
operations.operation: Feeds a generated heartbeat sequence to the real HysteresisStateMachine, recalculates routes with Dijkstra and simulates the transfer with the TCP model.
operations.evidence: netrescue.labs.integration contains no socket, subprocess or resolver calls
limitations: Heartbeats are generated, not probed; no operating-system route is changed.

definitions.REAL: The operation is performed against the operating system or a real socket on this machine.
definitions.SIMULATION: The result is produced by a model or algorithm; no corresponding live network operation occurs.
definitions.MIXED: The feature contains both kinds; each result section is labelled separately.
